outputs: natural language sequence Y representing the intervention to counter toxic meme content

changes_made.explanation: Normalized GPT3.5-Turbo to GPT-3.5-Turbo for consistency with standard naming conventions
Removed 'BLEUavg' and 'Hmean' as they are composite/derived metrics rather than base automatic evaluation metrics. Kept only the base metrics (ROUGE, BLEU, BERTScore) as per normalization guidelines.
No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators in this paper. The LLMs mentioned were used for generation purposes only.

guideline: Human evaluators assess generated interventions based on four aspects: Fluency (grammatical correctness), Adequacy (relevance to meme), Persuasiveness (persuasive ability), and Informativeness (correctly capturing meme context)
Evaluators rate interventions using 5-point Likert scales for each criterion

changes_made.explanation: Normalized criteria to title case and removed duplicates. Consolidated guideline description.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on meme intervention generation using LLMs/VLMs. It evaluates generated interventions using both automatic metrics (ROUGE, BLEU, BERTScore) and human evaluation. The extraction was generally accurate, requiring only minor normalization and removal of composite metrics. The paper does not use LLMs as judges/evaluators.
